Currency.description: The currencies an account can be denominated in. Backed by the ISO 4217 code rather than an int — unlike every other enum here — because the code *is* the identifier the rest of the stack speaks: moneyphp, `Intl.NumberFormat`, and the `char(3)` columns all round-trip it verbatim.  Every case must have an ISO minor unit of 2, because storage is `*_cents` columns and the whole codebase reads them as hundredths. CurrencyTest enforces it, so adding JPY (0 decimals) or TND (3) fails the suite rather than quietly mis-stating amounts by two orders of magnitude.
Currency.title: Currency

ExpenseVatStatus.description:
Where a purchase's TVA stands with the CA3. Derived on every read from the receipt, the claim period and the declared months — never stored, so un-marking a declaration honestly flips the rows back. | | |---| | `0`
Receipted and waiting for its CA3 to be declared. | | `1`
Its CA3 was marked declared: the deduction is filed. | | `2`
Claimed on a later CA3 than the purchase month, by choice or because that month was already declared. | | `3`
No receipt: the fisc refuses the deduction until one is attached. | | `4`
Autoliquidation: due and deducted on the same CA3, nothing to recover. | | `5`
Exempt purchase, a receipt whose TVA is not tracked, or an account that files no CA3. |
ExpenseVatStatus.title: ExpenseVatStatus

ExpenseVatTreatment.description:
How the TVA on a purchase reaches the CA3. The receipt decides, never the supplier's country: a foreign SaaS billing through a European entity with 20 % on the invoice is Domestic. | | |---| | `0`
A French invoice carrying TVA at the stated rate. | | `1`
An EU supplier who invoiced without TVA against the intra-community number (autoliquidation). | | `2`
A non-EU supplier who invoiced without TVA (autoliquidation). | | `3`
No TVA at all: insurance, bank fees, stamps, CFE. |
ExpenseVatTreatment.title: ExpenseVatTreatment

Handed to the platform: the mandatory starting point. | | `201`
The sender's platform passed it on. | | `202`
The recipient's platform took it. | | `204`
The buyer acknowledged it. | | `205`
| | `206`
| | `207`
| | `210`

The buyer sent the payment. | | `212`
